## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's in the way? Describe the listener or
developer need, not the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like Phonq to do. Keep it concrete — a button, a route, an API
endpoint, a page.

## Alternatives

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've considered.

## How this helps Phonq

Who benefits and why. This helps us prioritise against the roadmap in
[ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) and the issues in [TODO.md](../../TODO.md).

## Nice-to-haves

- [ ] Small enough for a first-time contributor?
- [ ] Docs update needed?
